feedback: The wider sensor spread and larger sensor size improved line detection coverage, helping the controller maintain the line better on complex curves. The increased base speed tested the robot's higher speed capability but led to a line loss event and off-track termination on the s-bend track, indicating the controller gains may need further tuning for stability at this speed. The controller compensated well on the oval track, finishing perfectly with low error. To improve, I recommend trying a slightly narrower sensor spread to reduce noise from off-line areas, lowering base speed slightly to 1.1 for better control balance, and increasing integral gain to 0.8 to help correct steady-state errors in curves.
